A '''male Anomid Jedi''' was a companion of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]]'s during the [[New Sith Wars]]. As with many [[Anomid/Legends|Anomids]], he was born without vocal cords and had to wear a [[vocalizer mask]] when communicating with non-Amonids. This Anomid Jedi was known to wield a blue [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], he took part in [[Operation Influx]], an ill-fated Jedi mission to sabotage [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] production in the [[Daimanate]], a fiefdom in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] ruled by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]. During the [[Raid on Chelloa]], the Anomid [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and several of his companions were killed during an attack by the rival [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]], whose [[kinetic corruptor]] destroyed a large area of the spaceport and surrounding town. The sole Jedi survivor of this mission was [[Kerra Holt]], a novice [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who would play an important part in the [[Chelloan affair]].
